research_question: When the model becomes materially stronger, does a verified prior Experience still improve correctness or the repair path, become unnecessary, or cause negative transfer?

execution_authority.reason: The active sprint permits no additional transfer check or new paid/external-model execution, and the prior transfer reservation remains unresolved.
required_before_activation: operator-approved policy revision with a new transfer case allowance
reconciled prior transfer minutes and cash-equivalent budget
confirmed access to every exact model identifier using existing subscriptions or an explicitly approved paid budget
fresh non-inheriting solver contexts with evaluator and cross-arm artifact isolation
frozen public task, repository revision, dependency lock, oracle and Experience digests
pre-registered arm order and stop conditions

phases.interpretation_limit: Exploratory feasibility and falsification only; no generalized model or AEG claim.
Requires a separate post-smoke activation gate and still supports only the frozen task family.

input_contract.control: No external Experience and no substitute repair advice.
input_contract.aeg_assisted: Exactly one frozen compact Experience; no target patch, hidden test, evaluator analysis or adapted answer.

stop_conditions: an agent can reach hidden evaluator data or another arm's artifacts
the Experience contains or reveals the target repair
the task, oracle, thresholds or metrics change after an outcome is observed
the target is a trivial one-shot task that cannot discriminate repair paths
model access, token telemetry, cost accounting or isolation is unresolved
any run would exceed the approved case, time, cash or deadline budget
